items.stem: What is the main goal of the discovery stage in a sale?

options.text: To understand the buyer's needs, pain and decision criteria
options.rationale: Correct: discovery builds the understanding needed to sell value, not features.

options.text: To present the full product demo immediately
options.rationale: Demos come after needs are understood.

options.text: To give the lowest possible price
options.rationale: Price is not the focus of discovery.

options.text: To close the deal on the first call

items.explanation: Correct: discovery builds the understanding needed to sell value, not features.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A prospect says 'your product is too expensive'. Which TWO responses handle the objection well? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Clarify what they are comparing the price to
options.rationale: Correct: understanding the reference point reframes the conversation.

options.text: Reconnect the price to the value and outcomes they cared about
options.rationale: Correct: value framing addresses the real concern behind price.

options.text: Immediately offer the largest available discount
options.rationale: Discounting first erodes margin and signals the price was inflated.

options.text: End the call because they cannot afford it
options.rationale: Assuming inability to pay abandons a workable objection.

items.explanation: Correct: clarify the comparison and reconnect to value.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Why should every sales interaction end with an agreed next step?

options.text: It keeps the deal moving and makes the pipeline forecastable
options.rationale: Correct: clear next steps prevent stalls and improve forecasting accuracy.

options.text: It guarantees the deal will close
options.rationale: It improves momentum but does not guarantee closing.

options.text: It replaces the need for discovery
options.rationale: Discovery is still essential earlier in the process.
Follow-up executes the agreed next step.

items.explanation: Correct: clear next steps prevent stalls and improve forecasting accuracy.
